audio.dimensionMusic.description: Choose what happens to the current track when using a portal.

items.Continue: Let the current track finish after changing dimensions.
items.Stop dimension tracks: End custom tracks assigned to the dimension you leave.
items.Stop all: End the current track whenever the dimension changes.

maps.colourMode.description: Choose the terrain colors used by both maps.

items.Textures: Use block texture colors and biome tints.
items.Native map: Use the original Beta map material colors.

maps.caveMode.description: Choose which terrain layer the maps display. Cave checks use loaded terrain only.

items.Surface: Map the highest terrain, including roofs above caves.
items.Automatic: Map a cave window around the camera below a solid roof and in the Nether.
items.Manual: Map a cave window centered on the selected reference height.

maps.waypointBobbing.description: Choose how in-game waypoint markers follow camera motion.

items.Fixed to screen: Remove walking view bobbing from marker projection while following camera movement.
items.Fixed to world: Let walking view bobbing move the view around markers at their world positions.

maps.playerIcon.description: Choose the marker for your current camera position on both maps.

items.Dot: The dot does not show facing direction.

sprint.activation.description: Choose how the sprint key starts and stops sprinting on foot.

items.Modern: Start while held, then keep sprinting until movement stops.
items.Hold: Hold the sprint key while moving forward. Double-tap sprint is independent.
items.Toggle: Press once to start sprinting and again to stop.

power_controls:userinterface.frontViewTh.description: Choose which perspectives the third-person key visits.

items.Disabled: Switch between first person and rear third person.
items.Normal: Include front third person in the perspective sequence.
items.Hide HUD: Use front view while the HUD is hidden in third person.

power_controls:features.moreSoundsChests.description: Choose sounds for opening and closing chests.

items.Modern: Use modern chest opening and closing sounds.
items.Door: Use Beta door opening and closing sounds.

power_hud:config.coordinateDisplay.description: Choose how coordinates appear in the debug overlay.

items.Hide: Remove coordinates from the debug overlay.
items.Randomize: Display disguised coordinates instead of the actual position.

tweaks.placement.slabMode.description: Choose how repeated fast placement handles slabs.

items.Continuous layers: Continue half-slab rows across exposed side faces.
items.Double slabs: Combine slab halves into double slabs.
items.Match first placement: Repeat the first slab configuration and keep its placement height.

tweaks.placement.restrictionMode.description: Restrict fast placement relative to the first placement.

items.Face: Use the same clicked face direction as the first placement.
items.Plane: Stay in the plane parallel to the first clicked face.
items.Layer: Stay at the same world height.
items.Column: Follow a column perpendicular to the first clicked face.
items.Line: Follow a straight axis within the first placement plane.
items.Diagonal: Follow a diagonal within the first placement plane.

tweaks.placement.listMode.description: Choose which held items can use fast placement. Ordinary placement is unchanged.

items.None: Allow every held item to use fast placement.
items.Blacklist: Prevent listed items from using fast placement.
items.Whitelist: Allow only listed items to use fast placement.
items.Off: Allow every held item to use fast placement.
items.Exclude: Prevent listed items from using fast placement.
items.Allow only: Allow only listed items to use fast placement.

lightOverlay.lightSource.description: Choose which light level the overlay measures.

items.Block light: Ignore daylight when checking build lighting.
items.Combined light: Include the current daylight and weather.

world.difficulty.description: Set combat difficulty and hostile mob spawning.

items.Peaceful: Remove hostile mobs and restore health over time.

items.Retro: Render the editable title lettering from blocks.
items.Beta: Use the original Beta logo image.

tweaks.freeLookPerspective.description: Choose the camera perspective while free look is active.

items.Third person: View the player from the detached third-person camera.
items.First person: Look around from the first-person camera.

native.renderDistance.description: Choose how far terrain is visible.

items.Far: Draw terrain up to 16 chunks away.
items.Normal: Draw terrain up to 8 chunks away.
items.Short: Draw terrain up to 4 chunks away.
items.Tiny: Draw terrain up to 2 chunks away.

native.fpsLimit.description: Limit rendering speed. VSync can impose a lower limit.

items.Balanced: Use a 120 FPS update budget without sleeping between frames.
items.Power saver: Cap rendering at 40 FPS and sleep between frames.

creative.sprintToggle.description: Choose how the shared flight sprint key activates faster flight.

items.Hold: Fly faster only while holding the shared flight sprint key.
items.Toggle: Press once to enable faster flight and again to stop. Stopping movement on all axes also resets it.

creative.spectatorSprintToggle.description: Choose how the shared flight sprint key activates faster flight.

items.Hold: Fly faster only while holding the shared flight sprint key.
items.Toggle: Press once to enable faster flight and again to stop. Stopping movement on all axes also resets it.

power_camera:config.sprintToggle.description: Choose how the shared flight sprint key activates faster flight.

items.Hold: Fly faster only while holding the shared flight sprint key.
items.Toggle: Press once to enable faster flight and again to stop. Stopping movement on all axes also resets it.

tweaks.freeLookToggle.description: Choose how the free-look key activates the camera.

items.Hold: Keep free look active only while holding the key.
items.Toggle: Press once to enable free look and again to disable it.

maps.middleClickAction.description: Choose what middle-click toggles over the minimap in inventory or pause screens, or while Enlarge minimap is held with mouse utilities enabled.

items.Show items: Toggle dropped item markers on the maps.
items.Show mobs: Toggle hostile and animal markers together.
items.Show waypoints: Toggle waypoint markers on the maps.
items.Show in-game waypoints: Toggle waypoint markers projected into the world.
items.Cave mode: Switch between surface mapping and the last selected cave mode.
items.Mob heads: Toggle minimap mob heads for this world visit. The mob-icons hold key clears this toggle.
items.Slime chunks: Toggle slime-chunk shading where the world seed is known.
items.Spawnable overlay: Toggle spawn-light shading near the camera.

recipeBook.buttonStyle.description: Choose the appearance of the recipe-book button.

items.Modern: Use the recipe-book icon beside the inventory.
items.Subtle: Place a small R beside the inventory sorting button.

power_hud:hudpositions.hudPositioningSys.description: Arrange and preview the HUD. Choose combined or separate positioning in the editor.

items.Vanilla: Keep the original Beta HUD positions.
items.Combined: Move the native HUD elements as a group.
items.Separate: Position the native HUD elements independently.

items.Show: Show the animated loading screen and its changing colors.
items.Forge-like: Show the Forge-style loading progress display.
items.Hide (vanilla): Use the original Minecraft loading-screen presentation.

power_mechanics:config.MOB_CONFIG.zombie.description: Choose zombie drops when Extra zombie drops is on.
Choose zombie-pigman drops when Extra zombie-pigman drops is on.

items.Gold sword: May drop one golden sword with random wear.
